purpose: V8 M5-M6: does an efficiency/matchup challenger beat the incumbent method on identical games?

cohort.historical: FBS vs FBS completed games, target seasons 2017-2025; 2020 reported separately and excluded from pooled gates
cohort.eligibility: both teams have at least 3 completed FBS games with play data before kickoff; every feature computed from games strictly before the game's week
cohort.authentic_2026: FBS vs FBS games with a timestamped incumbent forecast generated before kickoff (data/pregame-2026-history.json)

baseline.historical: incumbent-method replay: cfb_analytics.ratings.calculate_ratings week by week (incumbent settings), preseason prior = the same method's previous-season final rating; talent, returning production and coaching terms unavailable historically and omitted. Labelled a retrospective replay, never an archived forecast.
baseline.authentic_2026: published incumbent pregame probabilities as recorded

challenger: ridge linear model of home margin on the baseline rating gap plus as-of opponent-adjusted offense/defense matchup features; probability from a logistic mapping fitted on training seasons only; trained only on seasons before the target season

unavailable_inputs.quarterback_changes: not acquired with pregame timestamps in this pass; N/A
unavailable_inputs.travel_altitude: no venue coordinates in the acquired sources; N/A
unavailable_inputs.coaching_scheme: V6 coaching records lack verified publication cutoffs; not eligible as pregame inputs

promotion_gates.authentic_2026_not_worse: challenger minus published incumbent Brier CI95 upper bound must be <= 0.01 (small sample; reported separately)
promotion_gates.feature_inclusion: an ablation group stays only if removing it worsens pooled held-out Brier

decision: No automatic promotion. Gates met -> recommend promotion for owner approval; otherwise retain the incumbent and ship descriptive analytics.
